headline: Daybreak cybersecurity models are now available on AWS, boosting enterprise security capabilities.

items.title: Daybreak models are now available on AWS
items.summary: OpenAI and AWS have collaborated to make Daybreak cybersecurity capabilities available through Amazon Bedrock. These models are designed to enhance enterprise security workflows by integrating advanced AI-driven cybersecurity tools into existing infrastructure. The models offer protection against various cyber threats, and their deployment through AWS provides scalability and reliability for enterprise clients.
items.why_it_matters: This development provides powerful AI-driven cybersecurity tools that can be integrated into enterprise environments, enhancing security measures against evolving threats.

items.title: Build Low-Latency Multilingual Voice Agents with NVIDIA Magpie TTS
items.summary: NVIDIA's new Magpie TTS tool enables developers to create low-latency multilingual voice agents with open weights and full deployment control. This tool is aimed at enhancing voice-driven applications by providing high-quality, responsive voice synthesis across multiple languages.

items.title: Using the GitHub Copilot SDK for Java
items.summary: GitHub has released a new SDK for Java developers to leverage GitHub Copilot. This SDK allows for integration within Java codebases, providing AI-assisted code completion and suggestions, enhancing productivity and reducing development time.

items.title: Towards an Argumentative Foundation for Evaluative AI
items.summary: This new research paper proposes a framework for Evaluative AI (EAI), which aims to support human decision-making by presenting multiple hypotheses with supportive and contradictory evidence, rather than single recommendations. This approach could enhance decision-making processes by incorporating diverse perspectives.

all_items.title: How ONESTRUCTION built the Ishigaki-IDS foundation model with AWS GenAIIC
all_items.summary: ONESTRUCTION, with technical advisory from the AWS Generative AI Innovation Center, built Ishigaki-IDS, a foundation model specialized for construction and BIM workflows. This architectural case study shows how they combined synthetic data, a three-stage training pipeline, and verifiable rewards on Amazon EC2 to build a domain model in a data-scarce field.

all_items.title: How Pixieset achieved 35% AI feature adoption by solving the right problem with Amazon Bedrock
all_items.summary: Photographers are among the most skeptical audiences for generative AI. Learn how Pixieset used Amazon Bedrock to launch an AI-generated alt text feature to millions of users in four months, reaching 35% adoption by automating the tedious image SEO work photographers avoid, without touching the creative craft they take pride in.

all_items.title: First Orion accelerates QA automation using Amazon Nova Act
all_items.summary: Learn how First Orion, a branded communications company, shifted from brittle script-based UI testing to AI-driven QA automation with Amazon Nova Act. By describing tests in plain English instead of maintaining selector-based code, they cut QA cycle times, freed engineering capacity, and caught regressions earlier.

all_items.title: Run interactive IDEs on Amazon EKS with SageMaker AI to power up your AI workflows

This post shows how to install and configure the add-on, connect from the browser and from VS Code over SSH-over-SSM, and move your team to OpenID Connect sign-in with Amazon Cognito.

all_items.title: How nOps shipped FinOps agents 75% faster with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
